title: Noether's 1918 paper linking symmetry and conservation
summary: An English translation of Noether's invariance paper is on arXiv; the theorem connects symmetries to conservation laws.
body: Emmy Noether's 1918 paper on invariant variational problems is the source of Noether's theorem: continuous symmetries of the action correspond to conservation laws. An English translation by M. A. Tavel is posted as arXiv:physics/0503066. In ordinary mechanics, time-translation symmetry corresponds to energy conservation and spatial translation to momentum conservation. The theorem is not a license to say "energy is conserved in every cosmological setting" without stating the symmetry. That extension is a further, more delicate claim.
